entry_conditions.expression: When RSI(14) on close drops below 25 and no position is open, enter long with size = 0.5.
If already in a half-size long position and RSI(14) drops below 20, add another 0.5 size at the new bar's open.

exit_conditions.expression: Exit the entire position when RSI(14) crosses above 50.
Close any open position at the regular session close.

position_sizing_rule: Two halves: 0.5 unit on first signal, +0.5 unit on second signal (total 1.0).
session_filters: No new entries within the last 30 minutes of the regular session.
All positions force-closed at the regular session close.
risk_controls: Maximum one position at a time (with up to two scale-in tranches).
No stop-loss is specified — exits rely on RSI mean reversion or EOD.

explicit_ambiguities.ambiguity: 'RSI(14)' does not specify the smoothing method — Wilder's smoothing vs simple moving average vs exponential.
explicit_ambiguities.assumption_used_for_backtest: Wilder's RSI on close prices, the standard Welles Wilder original.
explicit_ambiguities.impact_if_different: SMA-based RSI is more reactive and would produce more sub-25 readings, likely increasing trade count and changing entry prices.

explicit_ambiguities.ambiguity: 'Half position' is undefined. There is no notion of total capital, leverage, or risk-per-trade.
explicit_ambiguities.assumption_used_for_backtest: Half position = 0.5 units, full = 1.0 units. PnL is reported per unit.
explicit_ambiguities.impact_if_different: Real risk-based sizing (e.g. fixed % of equity) would change drawdown and Sharpe but not win-rate.

explicit_ambiguities.ambiguity: 'End of day' is undefined: regular hours close 16:00 ET, extended hours run later.
explicit_ambiguities.assumption_used_for_backtest: Regular session close: last 15-min bar of the regular trading day.
explicit_ambiguities.impact_if_different: Holding into extended hours would expose the strategy to thin-liquidity gaps not modelled here.

explicit_ambiguities.ambiguity: The strategy does not say whether to re-enter the same day after an exit.
explicit_ambiguities.assumption_used_for_backtest: Allow re-entry after a full exit, subject to all other filters.
explicit_ambiguities.impact_if_different: A 'one trade per day' rule would cap exposure and mechanically lower trade count.

explicit_ambiguities.ambiguity: There is no stop-loss rule; the position is exposed indefinitely until RSI mean-reverts or EOD hits.
explicit_ambiguities.assumption_used_for_backtest: No stop-loss; exits only on RSI > 50 or EOD.
explicit_ambiguities.impact_if_different: Adding a max adverse excursion stop would cap tail-loss but also truncate winning recoveries.

explicit_ambiguities.ambiguity: Behaviour when RSI re-crosses 25→20→25→20 within the same position.
explicit_ambiguities.assumption_used_for_backtest: Second tranche fires only once per position; further crosses while in-position do nothing.
explicit_ambiguities.impact_if_different: A 'pyramid' interpretation would build larger and larger exposure on continued weakness.

explicit_ambiguities.assumption_used_for_backtest: For RSI(14) use Wilder smoothing on regular-session 15m bars only; treat the last 30-minute blackout as 16:00-15:30 ET inclusive.
explicit_ambiguities.impact_if_different: Recorded by a human reviewer at low-confidence prompt; supersedes the model's interpretation where applicable.

human_review.override_notes: For RSI(14) use Wilder smoothing on regular-session 15m bars only; treat the last 30-minute blackout as 16:00-15:30 ET inclusive.
